about:
Hudson Scientific LLC operates from Hudson, Michigan. The company was founded by FDA and ISO regulatory experts to provide a seamless concept-to-market solution for medical device and drug companies.

The firm offers contract manufacturing, regulatory consulting, pharmaceutical manufacturing, and medical device manufacturing services from an FDA-compliant facility that includes an environmentally controlled room for contaminant-free production. Its integrated team of engineers, quality assurance specialists, and regulatory experts handles FDA compliance, while business and distribution professionals assist with product establishment and marketing. Additional services include device assembly and kitting, as well as FDA initial import services.

Hudson Scientific serves medical device and pharmaceutical companies seeking to bring products to market. Its customer base includes firms requiring FDA regulatory navigation and GMP-compliant manufacturing.

The company emphasizes its integrated approach, combining technical, regulatory, and commercial expertise under one roof to deliver competitive pricing and a streamlined path from concept to market.
